# Eternal Vowz (E&V) — Bespoke 3D Digital Wedding Invitations & Live RSVP Platform
> Create royal 3D Lifafa and 3D Shahi Palace Gate digital wedding invitations at just ₹99 per card with live RSVP tracking, custom music, and personalized WhatsApp links.

## Overview
Eternal Vowz is a luxury digital wedding invitation platform offering animated 3D envelope experiences, wax seal animations, guest-by-guest RSVP tracking, countdown timers with scratchable reveals, interactive wedding event schedules, venue Google Maps integration, and zero app downloads required.

## Key Offerings & Features
- **Pricing:** Flat ₹99 per card (one-time fee). No hidden costs or subscriptions.
- **Card Validity:** Card 30 Days tak active rahega with live guest RSVP tracking.
- **Reveal Styles:**
  1. Royal Embossed Lifafa Envelopes with crackable wax seals.
  2. 3D Shahi Palace Double-Door Gates that unlock with golden keys.
  3. Frosted Botanical Pearl Veils with floral flourishes.
- **Guest Personalization:** Unlimited unique guest invitation links ("For Honored Guest & Family").
- **RSVP Tracking:** Host dashboard with real-time Accept/Decline counts, dietary notes, and guest counts.

## 8 Signature Wedding Invitation Designs
- **Pearl Botanical Veil:** Ivory & champagne gold botanical wedding card with audio chimes.
- **Shahi Palace Gates:** 3D royal fort entrance with gold filigree and regal dhol music.
- **Tuscan Sunset Rose:** Mediterranean courtyard with terracotta accents and acoustic sitar.
- **Royal Mughal Arch:** Heritage archways with intricate jaali patterns and shehnai melodies.
- **Celestial Starlight:** Midnight navy & starlight gold with modern romantic tones.
- **Kashmir Chinar Lotus:** Emerald & gold autumn foliage with traditional folk rhythms.
- **Shahi Crimson & Zari:** 24K gold zari on deep royal crimson velvet aesthetic.
- **Jodhpur Sapphire Darbar:** Blue city palace courtyards with majestic imperial fanfare.
